# Junior Workflow Settings
# Generated by j-setup on 2026-06-23
# Run j-setup again to modify

## Project
@project-name: my-app
@project-type: fullstack
@language: csharp

## Branches
@main-branch: master
@dev-branch:
@merge-strategy: direct

## Folders
@code: src/
@backend: src/
@frontend: web/
@tasks: tasks/
@docs: docs/
@tools: tools/

## Commands
@test-backend: dotnet test
@test-frontend: npm test --prefix web
@build: dotnet build
@start-backend: dotnet run --project src/MyApp.Server
@start-frontend: npm start --prefix web
@migrations-add: dotnet ef migrations add --project src/MyApp.Infrastructure --startup-project src/MyApp.Server
@migrations-apply: dotnet ef database update --project src/MyApp.Infrastructure --startup-project src/MyApp.Server

## Ports
@frontend-port: 4200
@backend-port: 5000
@db-port: none

## Deploy
@deploy-script: none
@deploy-docs: none
@domain: none
@backup-script: none
@restore-script: none

## Auth
@auth-method: none
@auth-notes:

## Database
@db-type: sqlite
@db-local: native

## Methodology
@backend-method: tddab
@frontend-method: chromedevtools
@tddab-file: .claude/commands/mind-sets/tddab-planner.md
@tddab-lang-overlay: csharp-tddab-overlay.md

## C# mindset version
# net10  → loads csharp-senior_10.md (DEFAULT — .NET 10, C# 14, xUnit v3, AwesomeAssertions, Scalar, .slnx)
# legacy → loads csharp-senior.md (only for existing net8.0/net9.0 projects that can't migrate)
# n/a    → project is not C#
@csharp-mindset: net10
